work.title: Flour for the common kitchen
work.body: Kael has begun helping with the kitchen cart. The delivery's result has not been recorded.

stages.body: Completed: flour reached the common kitchen, and Rook could move the emptied cart. Three households received supper.
In hand: carry the flour to the common kitchen table beside the well. Rook is holding the cart while Kael makes room to move it.

work.title: A road the kitchen cart can use
work.body: The drain and boards need attention. Their repair has not been recorded.

stages.body: Completed: the drain is clear and the boards are seated. Tor drove the final peg; the kitchen cart has a usable road.
In hand: take Tor's spade to the blocked drain beside the loose boards. Clear the water before settling the road surface.

work.title: Two household shares
work.body: The household relief task is known. The full delivery result has not been recorded.

stages.body: Completed: both households received their shares in person. Receiving food did not require an oath or a promise to speak.
The west household's delivery is recorded. Carry the remaining share to the east doorstep marked by a linen basket.
The east household's delivery is recorded. Carry the remaining share to the west doorstep marked by a linen basket.
In hand: deliver the two shares to the west and east doorsteps with linen baskets. The help remains available without signatures.

work.title: The mill workers' way out
work.body: The workers' exit is known. Whether they reached safety has not been recorded.

stages.body: Completed: both workers reached clean air in the south yard. They can bring their wage accounts to Greyfen themselves.
Under way: lead the workers through the cleared channel toward the south yard. Stay within a few paces; they stop when left behind.
The sluice has cleared a route. Call the workers into the channel and stay with them until they reach clean air.
Preserved: the wage chest is above the floodline. The workers' shares can be proved regardless of the mill's operational future.

work.title: What the mill encounter left behind

stages.body: Recorded result: the fire was contained. This does not decide the fate of the accounts or the terms on which milling continues.
Recorded result: fire scorched the mill. Repairs will take material and labor; the damage itself does not determine anyone's consent.
Recorded consequence: workers breathed too much smoke and need care. Reaching the yard does not make the exposure harmless.
Recovered: fragments of the damaged name-board were kept. Several names survive; its complete account was lost in the confrontation.
Protected: the name-board was lifted into dry cloth before the roots could consume its account.
The name-board was damaged. Return to the disturbed roots and recover what can still be read. A missing recovery record does not establish that nothing survived.
Completed: two marked roots were redirected, opening the ground again. The landscape changed without making another person's promise for them.
Completed: the bell rope was released. Its warning can still be remembered without treating every silence as safety.
Known: Kael learned the bell's rhythm. Read the raised clapper as well as the sound, and use the marked rope when the encounter permits it.
Completed: the account returned to Greyfen. Anwen and the people of the village can hear what the chosen resolution requires of the living.
Return to the names with Anwen in Greyfen. The covenant has been resolved; the people affected still need their account brought home.
Promised and begun: Kael took a place with Tor and Rook at the workbench. The practical rebuilding belongs to the people who choose to share it.
Join Tor and Rook at the workbench. Hear what tomorrow requires, then take responsibility for Kael's part.
Completed: Kael met the road beyond the kitchen. The outcome stands, and known places remain open to revisit.
Walk to the road beyond the common kitchen. Take in what this journey has changed before deciding where to go next.
